255	apply_arm_toggles() {
256	  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
257	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
258	  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
259	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
260	  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
261	  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
262	  local key val
263	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
264	    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
265	    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
266	      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
267	    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
268	      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
269	    fi
270	    case "$key" in
271	      companion_voice)
272	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
273	          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
274	        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
275	        ;;
276	      karpathy_block)
277	        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
278	        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
279	        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
280	        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
281	          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
282	        fi
283	        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
284	        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
285	          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
286	          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
287	            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
288	          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
289	          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
290	          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
291	        fi
292	        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
293	        ;;
294	      rule_files)
295	        local r gone=""
296	        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
297	          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
298	          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
299	        done
300	        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
301	        ;;
302	      audit_delta_instruction)
303	        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
304	        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
305	        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
306	          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
307	        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
308	        ;;
309	      loa_mount)
310	        local p left=""
311	        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
312	          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
313	        done
314	        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
315	        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
316	        ;;
317	      effort)
318	        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
319	        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
320	          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
321	          total=$((total + 1))
322	          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
323	          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
324	        done
325	        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
326	        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
327	        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
328	          local nkeys
329	          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
330	          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
331	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
332	          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
333	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
334	          local wrong
335	          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
336	          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
337	          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
338	          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
339	            local h
340	            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
341	            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
342	            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
343	            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
344	          fi
345	        fi
346	        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
347	        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
348	        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
349	        ;;
350	      gates)
351	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
352	          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
353	        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
354	        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
355	        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
356	        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
357	        ;;
358	      flatline)
359	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
360	          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
361	        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
362	        ;;
363	      sprint_plan)
364	        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
365	        ;;
366	      context_resets)
367	        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
368	        ;;
369	      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
370	    esac
371	  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
372	  return 0
373	}

376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
377	  local ws="$1"
378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
381	    return 0
382	  fi
383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
388	  else
389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
394	    : > "$sums"
395	    local -a batch=()
396	    local f
397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
398	      batch+=("$f")
399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
401	        batch=()
402	      fi
403	    done < "$list"
404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
406	    fi
407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
413	  fi
414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
415	  local digest
416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
419	  return 0

--- base/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh	2026-10-21 04:04:22.861558387 +0000

 }
 
+# cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.3): three outcomes per manifest path.
+#   present, hash matches            -> ok
+#   present, hash differs            -> Tampered (fail)
+#   absent, submodule mount detected (.loa/.claude is a directory) and the
+#     path exists under .loa/<path>   -> not-mounted (counted, one summary
+#     line, informational: never changes the exit code; the mount links a
+#     subset of the upstream tree by design)
+#   absent otherwise                 -> Missing (fail)
+# The manifest is read once (path<TAB>hash) instead of one jq call per path.
 check_integrity() {
   echo "Checking System Zone integrity (sha256)..."
   [[ -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]] || { warn "No checksums file - skipping integrity check"; return; }
 
   local drift=false
-  while IFS= read -r file; do
-    local expected=$(jq -r --arg f "$file" '.files[$f]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
-    [[ -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
+  local submodule_mount=false
+  local not_mounted=0
+  local file expected actual
+  [[ -d ".loa/.claude" ]] && submodule_mount=true
+
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r file expected; do
+    [[ -z "$file" || -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
 
     if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
-      local actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+      actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
       if [[ "$expected" != "$actual" ]]; then
         fail "Tampered: $file"
         drift=true
       fi
+    elif [[ "$submodule_mount" == "true" && -f ".loa/${file}" ]]; then
+      not_mounted=$((not_mounted + 1))
     else
       fail "Missing: $file"
       drift=true
     fi
-  done < <(jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
+  done < <(jq -r '.files | to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
 
+  if [[ $not_mounted -gt 0 ]]; then
+    log "not-mounted: ${not_mounted} path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"
+  fi
   [[ "$drift" == "false" ]] && log "Integrity verified"
+  return 0
 }

         EXPECTED_COUNT=$(jq -r '.files | length' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
-        ACTUAL_COUNT=$(find "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude" -type f ! -path "*/.git/*" ! -path "*/overrides/*" ! -path "*/checksums.json" | wc -l)
+        # cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267): the manifest is generated from the TRACKED
+        # .claude/ tree (tools/gen-checksums.sh), so count with the same rule:
+        # git ls-files -- .claude minus overrides/ and the manifest. In a
+        # submodule mount .claude/checksums.json links into the submodule; the
+        # count is taken in the tree that owns the manifest.
+        MANIFEST_TREE="${PROJECT_ROOT}"
+        if [[ -L "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json" ]]; then
+            MANIFEST_LINK=$(readlink "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json")
+            [[ "${MANIFEST_LINK}" == /* ]] || MANIFEST_LINK="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/${MANIFEST_LINK}"
+            MANIFEST_TREE=$(cd "$(dirname "${MANIFEST_LINK}")/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || MANIFEST_TREE="${PROJECT_ROOT}"
+        fi
+        ACTUAL_COUNT=0
+        if git -C "${MANIFEST_TREE}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+            ACTUAL_COUNT=$(git -C "${MANIFEST_TREE}" ls-files -- .claude \

+        fi
+        # No tracked .claude/ in that tree (outside git, or a standard-mode

+        if [[ "${ACTUAL_COUNT}" -eq 0 ]]; then
+            ACTUAL_COUNT=$(find "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude" -type f ! -path "*/.git/*" ! -path "*/overrides/*" ! -path "*/checksums.json" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
+        fi
 
         if [[ "${EXPECTED_COUNT}" != "${ACTUAL_COUNT}" ]]; then
             echo "⚠️  System Zone integrity check: file count mismatch" >&2

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
4	#
5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
10	#
11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
14	#
15	# Derived fields:
16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
36	#
37	# Usage:
38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
41	#
42	# Options:

44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
54	#                      bad row naming its line number
55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
56	#
57	# Exit codes:
58	#   0  row written / file valid
59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
    47	#
    48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
    55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    58	#
    59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
    60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
    61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
    62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
    63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
    64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
    65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
    66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
    67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
    69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
    70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
    71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
    73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
    74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
    75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
    76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
    77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
    78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
    79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
    80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
    81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
    82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
    83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
    84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
    85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
    86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
    87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
    88	#
    89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
    90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
    91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
    92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
    93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
    94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
    95	#
    96	# Exit codes:
    97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from

    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# execute-agent.sh — agent-execution step for Loa Eval Sandbox trials
#
# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9 / SDD §3.6). Fills the slot at the top of the
# grading step in run-eval.sh: a task that declares `.agent.skill` runs the
# headless Claude CLI inside the sandbox before its graders; every other task
# takes the pre-existing path untouched.
#
# What it does, in order:
#   1. Gate: no `.agent.skill` in the task YAML → exit 3, nothing written.
#   2. Materialize the prompt surface from $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE into the sandbox:
#        <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/        (SKILL.md + resources/)
#        <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md      (+ .claude/rules/)
#        <ws>/CLAUDE.md                      → "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
#        <ws>/.eval/skill-prompt.md          (SKILL.md body, frontmatter stripped)
#      The prompt tree is the ONLY thing that differs between A/B arms, so it
#      is recorded: prompt_tree_sha = `git rev-parse HEAD:.claude` of the tree,
#      prompt_tree_commit, and whether .claude/ had uncommitted changes.
#   3. Run:  claude -p "<task.prompt>" --output-format stream-json --verbose
#              --model $EVAL_MODEL [--effort <e>] --restricted --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Write
#              --permission-mode acceptEdits --append-system-prompt-file <skill-prompt>
#              --max-turns $EVAL_MAX_TURNS
#      --restricted --tools names the SDD's fixed tool set EXACTLY: it removes the
#      code-running tools, ignores the operator's user/project/local settings (their
#      Bash(...) allow rules leaked into the sprint-237 A/B arms under --allowed-tools,
#      which only adds rules) and confines Read/Grep/Glob/Write to the sandbox.
#      Edit/MultiEdit are therefore unavailable; the transcript extractor below still
#      records them defensively.
#      cwd = sandbox; env-isolated (LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH / LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and
#      TMPDIR into the sandbox; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/OPENAI_API_KEY/AWS_* unset;
#      HOME and PATH stay so the CLI finds its own credentials and toolchain).
#   4. Record <ws>/.eval/events.jsonl (raw stream), agent-output.json (the
#      `result` event) and executor.json:
#        {schema_version, skill, model_requested, model_id (the id the CLI
#         echoed — the modelUsage entry with the most output tokens), effort,
#         prompt_tree_sha, prompt_tree_commit, prompt_tree_dirty, exit_code,
#         is_error, duration_ms, num_turns, total_cost_usd, usage{…},
#         tool_writes:[{seq,tool,path}] in transcript order}
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  agent ran (its own verdict is the graders' business)
#   1  the CLI exited non-zero or timed out (executor.json still written)
#   2  infrastructure error (CLI binary missing, prompt tree lacks the skill)
#   3  task declares no agent (caller should not have called us)
#
# Env:
#   EVAL_MODEL          model passed to --model            (default claude-sonnet-5)
#   EVAL_EFFORT         override effort                    (default: task/skill)
#   EVAL_PROMPT_TREE    repo whose .claude/ is materialized (default: this repo)
#   EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN     CLI executable                     (default: claude)
#   EVAL_MAX_TURNS      --max-turns                        (default 40)
#
# Control arms (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.1):
#   LOA_EVAL_ARM          arm id (default baseline). Setting it at all is "arm
#                         mode": the prompt tree's .loa.config.yaml is also
#                         materialised so every arm sees the same config.
#   LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES  JSON object {toggle: false, …}; when unset the arm is
#                         resolved from LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, else from
#                         evals/suites/<task dir name>.yaml (`ab.arms[]`)
----
  sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,95p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2
  exit 2
}

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --task-yaml) TASK_YAML="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --workspace) WORKSPACE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-id) RUN_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --trial-id) TRIAL_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --timeout) TIMEOUT_S="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) echo "ERROR: Unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" && -n "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: --task-yaml and --workspace are required" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || { echo "ERROR: task YAML not found: $TASK_YAML" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -d "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: workspace not found: $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 2; }
WORKSPACE="$(cd "$WORKSPACE" && pwd)"

# --- 1. gate ---------------------------------------------------------------
skill="$(yq -r '.agent.skill // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
if [[ -z "$skill" || "$skill" == "null" ]]; then
  echo "execute-agent: task declares no .agent.skill — nothing to run" >&2
  exit 3
fi
case "$skill" in
  */*|.*|'') echo "ERROR: invalid skill name '$skill'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

PROMPT_TREE="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$REPO_ROOT}"
PROMPT_TREE="$(cd "$PROMPT_TREE" && pwd)"
CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
MODEL="${EVAL_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-5}"
MAX_TURNS="${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}"

skill_src="$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/skills/$skill"
[[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { echo "ERROR: prompt tree $PROMPT_TREE has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || { echo "ERROR: CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN (set EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN)" >&2; exit 2; }

# --- 2. materialize ----------------------------------------------------------
# The materialisation and toggle functions live in lib/sandbox-mount.sh (cycle-130
# Task 1.6, shared with pipeline-run.sh); the arm is resolved first because
# loa_mount: false skips the prompt surface entirely.
eval_dir="$WORKSPACE/.eval"
mkdir -p "$eval_dir"

# --- 2b. control arm (cycle-129 FR-2) -----------------------------------------
ARM_MODE=false
[[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" ]] && ARM_MODE=true
ARM="${LOA_EVAL_ARM:-baseline}"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid LOA_EVAL_ARM '$ARM'" >&2; exit 2; }

# The arm's toggles: explicit JSON, else the suite's arms[] / ab.arms[] entry.
resolve_toggles() {
  # audit r1 DISS-C-001: toggles exist only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set); a stale
  # LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES in a non-arm environment is ignored, and the baseline arm
  # never carries toggles.
  if [[ "$ARM_MODE" != "true" ]]; then
    [[ -z "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]] || echo "WARN: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is set but LOA_EVAL_ARM is not: ignored (not an arm run)" >&2
    printf '{}'; return 0
  fi
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]]; then
    jq -ce 'if type == "object" then . else error("not an object") end' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES" 2>/dev/null \
      || { echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is not a JSON object" >&2; return 2; }
    if [[ "$ARM" == "baseline" && "$(jq -c 'length' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES")" != "0" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: the baseline arm takes no toggles (LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES=$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES)" >&2; return 2
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  local suite_file="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-}"
  if [[ -z "$suite_file" ]]; then
    local tdir; tdir="$(basename "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")")"
    [[ -f "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml" ]] && suite_file="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml"
  fi
  resolve_arm_toggles "$ARM" "$suite_file"
}
ARM_TOGGLES="$(resolve_toggles)" || exit 2

# cycle-130: sprint_plan and context_resets edit the phase set of the pipeline
# executor; the single-skill path has no phases, so they cannot take effect here.
for k in sprint_plan context_resets; do
  if [[ "$(K="$k" jq -r 'has(env.K)' <<<"$ARM_TOGGLES")" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' toggle $k applies to the pipeline executor (pipeline-run.sh) only" >&2; exit 2
  fi
done
LOA_MOUNT=true
[[ "$(jq -r 'if has("loa_mount") then (.loa_mount | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$ARM_TOGGLES")" == "false" ]] && LOA_MOUNT=false

skill_dst="$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills/$skill"
if [[ "$LOA_MOUNT" == "true" ]]; then
  ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE=/dev/null mount_prompt_surface "$WORKSPACE" "$PROMPT_TREE" "$skill" || exit 2
fi

# Toggles hit the sandbox copy only, after every materialisation step; each is
# verified and one that cannot take effect is exit 2 before the executor starts.
if [[ "$ARM_MODE" == "true" ]]; then
  # an operator's gate override never reaches an arm that did not declare it
  unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE
fi
arm_ev_file="$(mktemp "$eval_dir/.arm-evidence.XXXXXX")"
ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$arm_ev_file" apply_arm_toggles "$WORKSPACE" "$ARM_TOGGLES" "$ARM" || { rm -f "$arm_ev_file"; exit 2; }
# The sandbox manifest is regenerated after the toggles so no integrity reader
# inside it reports Tampered (DEC-0421); arm mode only, when a .claude/ exists.
if [[ "$ARM_MODE" == "true" && -d "$WORKSPACE/.claude" ]]; then
  ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$arm_ev_file" regen_sandbox_manifest "$WORKSPACE" || { rm -f "$arm_ev_file"; exit 2; }
fi
ARM_EVIDENCE="$(jq -Rn '[inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$") | {(.k): .v}] | add // {}' < "$arm_ev_file")"
rm -f "$arm_ev_file"

# Skill body without the YAML frontmatter → the appended system prompt. Read
# from the (toggled) sandbox copy so an arm reaches the system prompt too.
if [[ "$LOA_MOUNT" == "true" ]]; then
  awk 'BEGIN{fm=0} NR==1 && $0=="---"{fm=1; next} fm==1 && $0=="---"{fm=2; next} fm!=1{print}' \
    "$skill_dst/SKILL.md" > "$eval_dir/skill-prompt.md"
fi

# Prompt-tree identity (what the A/B is actually varying).
prompt_tree_sha="$(git -C "$PROMPT_TREE" rev-parse HEAD:.claude 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
prompt_tree_commit="$(git -C "$PROMPT_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
# audit r1 DISS-C-009: a declared source commit is a hex id and, when the prompt tree's
# HEAD is known, the same commit — otherwise two trials from different trees could
# present one source_commit and pass compare.sh's skew check.
if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT:-}" ]]; then
  [[ "$LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] \

[[ "$LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] \
    || { echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT is not a hex commit id" >&2; exit 2; }
  if [[ "$prompt_tree_commit" != "unknown" && "$prompt_tree_commit" != "$LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT"* ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT ($LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT) is not the prompt tree's HEAD ($prompt_tree_commit)" >&2; exit 2
  fi
fi
prompt_tree_dirty=false
if [[ -n "$(git -C "$PROMPT_TREE" status --porcelain -- .claude 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
  prompt_tree_dirty=true
fi

# Effort: env > task > skill frontmatter > none; invalid → none.
resolve_effort() {
  local cand="${EVAL_EFFORT:-}"
  if [[ -z "$cand" ]]; then
    cand="$(yq -r '.agent.effort // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
  fi
  if [[ ( -z "$cand" || "$cand" == "null" ) && "$LOA_MOUNT" == "true" ]]; then
    cand="$(awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---"{exit} NR>1 && $0=="---"{exit} NR>1{print}' "$skill_src/SKILL.md" \
      | yq -r '.effort // ""' 2>/dev/null || true)"
  fi
  case "$cand" in
    low|medium|high|xhigh|max) printf '%s' "$cand" ;;
    *) printf '' ;;
  esac
}
effort="$(resolve_effort)"
# cycle-130: an arm's effort toggle is the treatment and overrides every other source
arm_effort="$(jq -r '.effort // ""' <<<"$ARM_TOGGLES")"
[[ -n "$arm_effort" ]] && effort="$arm_effort"

prompt="$(yq -r '.prompt // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
[[ -n "$prompt" && "$prompt" != "null" ]] || { echo "ERROR: task has no prompt" >&2; exit 2; }

# --- 3. run ------------------------------------------------------------------
argv=(
  "$CLAUDE_BIN" -p "$prompt"
  --output-format stream-json --verbose
  --model "$MODEL"
  --restricted --tools "Read,Grep,Glob,Write"
  --permission-mode acceptEdits
)
# loa_mount: false (cycle-130 a0_bare): the task prompt only, no appended skill prompt
[[ "$LOA_MOUNT" == "true" ]] && argv+=(--append-system-prompt-file "$eval_dir/skill-prompt.md")
argv+=(--max-turns "$MAX_TURNS")
[[ -n "$effort" ]] && argv+=(--effort "$effort")

events="$eval_dir/events.jsonl"
stderr_log="$eval_dir/agent-stderr.log"
start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
rc=0
(
  cd "$WORKSPACE" || exit 2
  export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$eval_dir/model-invoke.jsonl"
  export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$eval_dir/cost-ledger.jsonl"
  export EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL"
  # sprint-237 audit HIGH-001: the CLI keeps HOME (its own credentials live there)
  # and PATH (its toolchain); the operator's other credentials are not the agent
  # under test's business, and its temp files stay inside the sandbox.
  unset GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
  # cycle-129: an executor started from inside a Claude Code session inherits
  # that session's coupling (child-session flag, session id, messaging socket,
  # agent teams) and its subagent model (the sprint-255 driver session carried
  # CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=opus). Decouple the session and pin every
  # auxiliary model to the executor model. (A safeguard-refusal fallback to
  # another model is a separate CLI behaviour, recorded below as
  # refusal_fallbacks; no environment setting turns it off.)
  unset CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET \
    CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED
  export CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL="$MODEL"
  mkdir -p "$eval_dir/tmp" && export TMPDIR="$eval_dir/tmp"
  exec timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 "$TIMEOUT_S" "${argv[@]}"
) > "$events" 2> "$stderr_log" || rc=$?
end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
duration_ms=$(( end_ms - start_ms ))

# --- 4. record ---------------------------------------------------------------
# The last `result` event is the CLI's summary (absent on crash/timeout).
result_json="$(grep -E '^\{.*"type" *: *"result"' "$events" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
if [[ -z "$result_json" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result_json"; then
  result_json='{"type":"result","subtype":"missing","is_error":true}'
fi
printf '%s\n' "$result_json" > "$eval_dir/agent-output.json"

# Ordered tool writes from the transcript (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit).
tool_writes="$(jq -c '
  select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? |
  select(.type=="tool_use" and (.name=="Write" or .name=="Edit" or .name=="MultiEdit" or .name=="NotebookEdit")) |
  {tool:.name, path:(.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc 'to_entries | map({seq:(.key+1), tool:.value.tool, path:.value.path})' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
[[ -n "$tool_writes" ]] || tool_writes='[]'

# cycle-129: a safeguard refusal makes the CLI retry the session on another
# model (system/model_refusal_fallback); the arm run must see it, because the
# output after it is not the requested executor's.
refusal_fallbacks="$(jq -c 'select(.type=="system" and .subtype=="model_refusal_fallback")
  | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null),
     scope: (.scope // null)}' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
[[ -n "$refusal_fallbacks" ]] || refusal_fallbacks='[]'

is_error="$(jq -r '.is_error // false' <<<"$result_json")"
[[ $rc -ne 0 ]] && is_error=true

jq -n \
  --arg skill "$skill" \
  --arg model_requested "$MODEL" \
  --arg effort "$effort" \
  --arg prompt_tree "$PROMPT_TREE" \
  --arg prompt_tree_sha "$prompt_tree_sha" \
  --arg prompt_tree_commit "$prompt_tree_commit" \
  --argjson prompt_tree_dirty "$prompt_tree_dirty" \
  --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" \
  --arg trial_id "$TRIAL_ID" \
  --argjson rc "$rc" \
  --argjson is_error "$is_error" \
  --argjson duration_ms "$duration_ms" \
  --argjson result "$result_json" \
  --argjson tool_writes "$tool_writes" \
  --arg arm "$ARM" \
  --argjson arm_toggles "$ARM_TOGGLES" \
  --argjson arm_evidence "$ARM_EVIDENCE" \
  --arg source_commit "${LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT:-$prompt_tree_commit}" \
  --argjson refusal_fallbacks "$refusal_fallbacks" \
  '
  def norm_usage(u): {
    input_tokens: (u.input_tokens // u.inputTokens // 0),
    output_tokens: (u.output_tokens // u.outputTokens // 0),
    cache_creation_input_tokens: (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // u.cacheCreationInputTokens // 0),
    cache_read_input_tokens: (u.cache_read_input_tokens // u.cacheReadInputTokens // 0)
  };
  ($result.modelUsage // {}) as $mu |
  # the model that produced the output: the modelUsage entry with the most
  # output tokens (a haiku helper call must not be mis-attributed — the
  # framework-review 2026-09-17 rec 5 class), else the requested id.
  (if ($mu | length) > 0
     then ($mu | to_entries | max_by(.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0) | .key)
     else $model_requested end) as $model_id |
  {
    schema_version: 1,
    skill: $skill,
    run_id: $run_id,
    trial_id: $trial_id,
    model_requested: $model_requested,
    model_id: $model_id,
    effort: $effort,
    prompt_tree: $prompt_tree,
    prompt_tree_sha: $prompt_tree_sha,
    prompt_tree_commit: $prompt_tree_commit,
    prompt_tree_dirty: $prompt_tree_dirty,
    exit_code: $rc,
    is_error: $is_error,
    duration_ms: $duration_ms,
    num_turns: ($result.num_turns // 0),
    total_cost_usd: ($result.total_cost_usd // 0),
    usage: norm_usage($result.usage // {}),
    models_used: ($mu | with_entries(.value = (.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0))),
    refusal_fallbacks: $refusal_fallbacks,
    tool_writes: $tool_writes,
    arm: $arm,
    arm_toggles: $arm_toggles,
    arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
    source_commit: $source_commit
  }' > "$eval_dir/executor.json"

if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "execute-agent: CLI exited $rc (see $stderr_log)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
exit 0

560	# copied: the Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK in the environment,
   561	# and --setting-sources project ignores user settings.
   562	CREDS_HOME="${LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME:-$HOME}"

   567	  # (the CLI otherwise ignores permissions.allow and warns; lead, Sprint 258 smoke)

   575	
   576	# --- pricing (one lookup per model; D-4.10) ---------------------------------------------
   577	PRICE_CACHE=""
   578	price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
   579	  local m="$1" hit alias j
   580	  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"
   581	  [[ -n "$hit" ]] && { printf '%s' "$hit"; return 0; }
   582	  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON:-}" ]]; then
   583	    j="$(jq -c --arg m "$m" '.[$m] // null' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
   584	  else
   585	    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
   586	    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \
   587	          --alias "$alias" --json 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
   588	    [[ -n "$j" ]] || j=null
   589	  fi
   590	  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
   591	              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
   592	                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
   593	                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}
   594	              else null end' <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
   595	  PRICE_CACHE="$PRICE_CACHE$m"$'\t'"$j"$'\n'
   596	  printf '%s' "$j"
   597	}
   598	# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
   599	price_events() {
   600	  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
   601	    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
   602	                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
   603	    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
   604	                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
   605	      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
   606	       .n += 1
   607	       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
   608	       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
   609	       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
   610	    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
   611	    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
   612	         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
   613	    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
   614	}
   615	
   616	# --- phase execution ----------------------------------------------------------------
   617	IMPL_SESSION="" LAST_VERDICT="none" CUR_LABEL=""
   618	in_container_path() { local p="$1"; printf '%s' "/workspace${p#"$WS"}"; }
   619	
   620	# ENV_SHIM <keys-csv> <cmd…>: close every descriptor above 2 (DEC-0412), keep exactly the
   621	# named environment variables, exec <cmd>. Used on the host (host mode, and around the
   622	# docker client) and inside the container. No eval (eval.yml trust boundary), and secret
   623	# values never appear in any argv: they travel in the environment only.
   624	ENV_SHIM='import os, sys
   625	keys = [k for k in sys.argv[1].split(",") if k]
   626	env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in keys if k in os.environ}
   627	os.closerange(3, 65536)

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}
   156	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   160	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   161	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   162	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   163	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   164	else
   165	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   166	fi
   167	
   168	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   169	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   170	rc=0
   171	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   172	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   173	cat "$OUT"
   174	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   175	
   176	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   177	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   178	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   179	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"
   180	[[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && exit 0
   181	exit 1

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
    65	
    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
    68	  local v
    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
    70	  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    71	  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
    72	  return 0
    73	}
    74	if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
    75	  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
    76	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
    77	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
    78	fi
    79	if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
    80	  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
    81	  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
    82	fi
    83	num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
    85	
    86	# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
    87	if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    88	  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
    89	  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
    90	fi
    91	EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
    92	if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
    93	  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
    94	  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    95	fi
    96	for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
    97	  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
    98	done
    99	if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
   100	  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
   101	else
   102	  LEDGER=""
   103	fi
   104	
   105	python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
   106	import json, sys
   107	from datetime import datetime, timezone
   108	
   109	since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
   110	runs_files = sys.argv[6:]

   112	def ts(s):

--- base/evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats	2026-10-21 04:04:22.862693300 +0000

+
+# --- cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (PRD AC-3.1, AC-3.2, AC-5.6; sprint AC-1.6, AC-1.10;
+# DEC-0421, DEC-0431, DEC-0433). The ablation-2.0 arms through execute-agent.sh, and
+# lib/sandbox-mount.sh called directly for the pipeline-shaped (whole-tree) mount.
+
+ABL_SUITE_REL="evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
+LIB_REL="evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
+
+lib() {  # lib <function> <args…> — one library call in a strict subshell
+  bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; source "$1"; shift; "$@"' _ "$REPO_ROOT/$LIB_REL" "$@"
+}
+
+# The prompt tree as the pipeline mounts it: a catalog with two default_effort
+# entries and its .checksum, a second skill with an effort line, the beads
+# state script, and an overrides/ file the manifest must skip.
+extend_tree() {
+  mkdir -p "$PT/.claude/defaults" "$PT/.claude/skills/implementing-tasks" "$PT/.claude/scripts/beads" "$PT/.claude/overrides"
+  printf '%s\n' "providers:" "  anthropic:" "    models:" "      claude-opus-5-5:" "        params:" "          default_effort: high" \
+    "      claude-fable-5-1:" "        params:" "          default_effort: xhigh" > "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml"
+  sha256sum_of "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" > "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml.checksum"
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: implementing-tasks" "effort: xhigh" "model: opus" "---" "# Implement" "effort: this body line stays" \
+    > "$PT/.claude/skills/implementing-tasks/SKILL.md"
+  cp "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh" "$PT/.claude/scripts/beads/"
+  echo "operator override" > "$PT/.claude/overrides/local.md"
+}
+sha256sum_of() { bash -c 'source "$1"; sha256_portable "$2" | cut -d" " -f1' _ "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh" "$1"; }
+
+# check-loa.sh's own integrity check, run inside the sandbox (its cwd-relative manifest)
+integrity_in() {
+  ( cd "$1" && bash -c 'source "$1" && { check_integrity || true; } && echo "FAILURES=$FAILURES"' _ "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh" )
+}
+
+@test "AT-13 ablation-2.0 declares the nine canonical arms, task_types per arm, A8 absent with its evidence, integrity_clean on every runnable arm (AC-1.10)" {
+  S="$REPO_ROOT/$ABL_SUITE_REL"
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[].id] | join(",")' "$S")" = "a0_bare,a1_full,a2_no_sprint_plan,a3_one_voice,a4_no_gates,a5_no_flatline,a6_one_window,a7_effort_medium,a8_no_ceremonies" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[] | select((.task_types | join(",")) == "build") | .id] | join(",")' "$S")" = "a2_no_sprint_plan,a4_no_gates,a5_no_flatline,a6_one_window" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[] | select((.task_types | join(",")) == "all") | .id] | join(",")' "$S")" = "a0_bare,a1_full,a3_one_voice,a7_effort_medium" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.arms[] | select(.id == "a8_no_ceremonies") | .absent' "$S")" = "true" ]
+  yq -r '.arms[] | select(.id == "a8_no_ceremonies") | .evidence' "$S" | grep -q 'grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/'
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[] | select(.absent != true) | select((.took_effect // []) | contains(["integrity_clean"]) | not)] | length' "$S")" = "0" ]
+  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 '.arms[] | select(.id == "a0_bare") | [.toggles, .phases, .effort]' "$S")" = '[{"loa_mount":false},["BARE"],"high"]' ]
+  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 '.arms[] | select(.id == "a7_effort_medium") | .toggles' "$S")" = '{"effort":"medium"}' ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.phase_defaults.max_turns.BARE, .phase_defaults.timeout_min.BARE, .phase_defaults.models.REVIEW' "$S" | tr '\n' ,)" = "170,70,global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1," ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.phase_sets.build | join(",")' "$S")" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX,AUDIT,FIX" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.rules.decision_states | length' "$S")" = "7" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.rules.predicates | keys | join(",")' "$S")" = "investigate,keep,inconclusive,remove,simplify" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.caps | [.cycle_usd, .run_usd, .reserve_usd] | join(",")' "$S")" = "1500,12,250" ]
+  # resolve_arm_toggles: absent and undeclared are refused; a1_full and an undeclared baseline are {}
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a8_no_ceremonies "$S"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; grep -q 'declared absent' <<<"$output"
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a9_nope "$S"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; grep -q 'not declared' <<<"$output"
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a1_full "$S"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "{}" ]
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a0_bare "$S"
+  [ "$output" = '{"loa_mount":false}' ]
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles baseline "$S"
+  [ "$output" = "{}" ]
+  # the cycle-129 suites still resolve through ab.arms[]
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles no_rule_files "$REVIEW_SUITE"
+  [ "$output" = '{"rule_files":false}' ]
+}

+@test "AT-14 a0_bare: no .claude/, CLAUDE.md or .loa.config.yaml at executor start, no --append-system-prompt-file, the task prompt only; skill effort is not read" {
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "effort: xhigh" "---" "# Review" > "$PT/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
+  export STUB_ARGV_FILE="$T/argv"
+  run_arm a0_bare "$REPO_ROOT/$ABL_SUITE_REL" reviewing-code
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ -d "$SNAP" ]
+  [ ! -e "$SNAP/.claude" ] && [ ! -e "$SNAP/CLAUDE.md" ] && [ ! -e "$SNAP/.loa.config.yaml" ] && [ ! -e "$SNAP/system-prompt.md" ]
+  [ ! -e "$WS/.claude" ] && [ ! -e "$WS/CLAUDE.md" ] && [ ! -e "$WS/.eval/skill-prompt.md" ]
+  ! grep -qx -- '--append-system-prompt-file' "$T/argv"
+  ! grep -qx -- '--effort' "$T/argv"
+  grep -qxF 'Read the instructions and carry them out.' "$T/argv"
+  [ "$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.loa_mount' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "none" ]
+  [ "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = '{"loa_mount":false}' ]

+  rm -rf "$SNAP"; mkdir -p "$WS/.claude"

+  [ ! -e "$SNAP" ]

+@test "AT-15 a7_effort_medium through execute-agent: --effort medium on argv (over EVAL_EFFORT and the skill's own effort), no effort: in the sandbox SKILL.md frontmatter" {
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "effort: xhigh" "---" "# Review" > "$PT/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
+  export STUB_ARGV_FILE="$T/argv"
+  EVAL_EFFORT=low run_arm a7_effort_medium "$REPO_ROOT/$ABL_SUITE_REL" reviewing-code
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(grep -x -A1 -- '--effort' "$T/argv" | tail -1)" = "medium" ]
+  [ "$(grep -cx -- '--effort' "$T/argv")" -eq 1 ]
+  ! grep -q '^effort:' "$SNAP/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
+  grep -q '^effort: xhigh' "$PT/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"

+  [ "$(jq -r '.effort' "$E")" = "medium" ]

+@test "AT-16 a7 on the whole-tree mount: every SKILL.md frontmatter stripped (body kept), every catalog default_effort medium, .checksum refreshed" {
+  extend_tree
+  W2="$T/ws2"; mkdir -p "$W2"
+  run lib mount_prompt_surface "$W2" "$PT" -
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "mount=tree" ]
+  [ -f "$W2/.loa.config.yaml" ] && [ -f "$W2/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md" ] && [ -f "$W2/.claude/overrides/local.md" ]
+  run lib apply_arm_toggles "$W2" '{"effort":"medium"}' a7_effort_medium
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]

+  grep -qx 'effort_skills_stripped=1/3' <<<"$output"

     5	# SDD §5.2). tools/check-manifest-paths.sh fails when the integrity manifest
     6	# lists a path that is not tracked (`git ls-files -- .claude`) or not present,
     7	# and labels untracked offenders with a diagnostic class. The classes apply to
     8	# untracked offenders only: a tracked `.lock` file is never flagged. Fixture
     9	# manifests are written by hand so each failure mode is isolated; MP-6 checks
    10	# the committed manifest of this repository.
    11	# =============================================================================
    12	
    13	setup() {
    14	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    15	  CMP="$ROOT/tools/check-manifest-paths.sh"
    16	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cmpaths.XXXXXX")"
    17	  R="$T/repo"
    18	  mkdir -p "$R/.claude/scripts/__pycache__" "$R/.claude/data"
    19	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$R/.claude/scripts/a.sh"
    20	  printf 'pinned\n' > "$R/.claude/data/deps.lock"
    21	  printf 'untracked\n' > "$R/.claude/scripts/stray.sh"
    22	  printf 'bytecode' > "$R/.claude/scripts/__pycache__/a.cpython-313.pyc"

    25	  git -C "$R" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit --quiet -m fixture

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/check-loa-mount-scope.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 #1267,
     5	# AC-1.2/AC-1.3; SDD §5.3). check-loa.sh check_integrity classifies every
     6	# manifest path as ok, Tampered (fail), not-mounted (a submodule mount does
     7	# not link it but .loa/<path> has it: counted, one summary line, never a
     8	# failure) or Missing (fail).
     9	#
    10	# Seam: check-loa.sh already guards `main` behind
    11	#   [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]
    12	# so each case sources the script in a child bash inside the fixture
    13	# directory and calls check_integrity alone; the child exits 1 when the
    14	# FAILURES counter is non-zero, the same rule main applies. No other check
    15	# runs, and the script is not modified for the test.
    16	# =============================================================================
    17	
    18	setup() {
    19	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    20	  CHECK="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh"
    21	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cloams.XXXXXX")"
    22	  D="$T/downstream"
    23	  # upstream tree inside the submodule path
    24	  mkdir -p "$D/.loa/.claude/lib" "$D/.claude"
    25	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh"
    26	  printf 'echo b\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh"
    27	  printf 'echo c\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh"
    28	  # the mount links a.sh only (b.sh and lib/c.sh are not linked)
    29	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/a.sh "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    30	  printf 'aleph:\n  enabled: false\n' > "$D/.loa.config.yaml"
    31	  source "$ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    32	  HA="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    33	  HB="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    34	  HC="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    35	  write_manifest
    36	}
    37	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    38	
    39	# write_manifest [extra-path hash]... — a/b/lib/c plus any extra pairs
    40	write_manifest() {
    41	  local args=(--arg a "$HA" --arg b "$HB" --arg c "$HC")
    42	  local filter='{".claude/a.sh": $a, ".claude/b.sh": $b, ".claude/lib/c.sh": $c}'
    43	  if [[ $# -ge 2 ]]; then
    44	    args+=(--arg xp "$1" --arg xh "$2")
    45	    filter="$filter + {(\$xp): \$xh}"
    46	  fi
    47	  jq -n "${args[@]}" "{generated: \"2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\", algorithm: \"sha256\", files: ($filter)}" \
    48	    > "$D/.claude/checksums.json"
    49	}
    50	
    51	run_integrity() {
    52	  run bash -c 'cd "$1" && source "$2" && check_integrity && echo "FAILURES=$FAILURES" && [[ $FAILURES -eq 0 ]]' \
    53	    _ "$D" "$CHECK"
    54	}
    55	
    56	@test "CM-1 paths in the upstream tree but not linked are not-mounted; exit unaffected" {
    57	  run_integrity
    58	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    59	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"* ]]
    60	  [[ "$output" == *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    61	  [[ "$output" != *"Missing:"* ]]
    62	  [[ "$output" != *"Tampered:"* ]]
    63	  [ "$(grep -c 'not-mounted:' <<< "$output")" -eq 1 ]
    64	}
    65	
    66	@test "CM-2 a present file whose hash differs is Tampered and fails" {
    67	  rm -f "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    68	  printf 'echo tampered\n' > "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    69	  run_integrity
    70	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    71	  [[ "$output" == *"Tampered: .claude/a.sh"* ]]
    72	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    73	  [[ "$output" == *"FAILURES=1"* ]]
    74	}
    75	
    76	@test "CM-3 a path absent locally and upstream is Missing and fails" {
    77	  write_manifest .claude/gone.sh "$HA"
    78	  run_integrity
    79	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    80	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/gone.sh"* ]]
    81	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s)"* ]]
    82	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    83	}
    84	
    85	@test "CM-4 without a .loa/ submodule an absent path is Missing" {
    86	  find "$D/.loa" -mindepth 1 -delete

    94	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/lib/c.sh"* ]]
    95	  [[ "$output" != *"not-mounted"* ]]
    96	}
    97	
    98	@test "CM-5 every path linked and matching: Integrity verified, no not-mounted line" {
    99	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/b.sh "$D/.claude/b.sh"
